defects.description: Glossary term “Subject” should be translated as “Объект обсуждения”, but the translation uses “Субъекты”.
Enum value “consensus” is not translated to the required term “Консенсус”.
Enum value “no-consensus” contains the term “consensus” which should be translated to “Консенсус”.
Enum value “blocked-escalation” contains the term “escalation” which should be translated to “Эскалация”.
Code tokens inside the ValidationResult snippet are altered (identifiers must be byte‑identical).
Field names in EscalationRecord are changed (code tokens must remain unchanged).
